response.justification: The candidate brings genuine geospatial domain experience (founder of GISCollective, Green Map GIS work) and proven low-latency systems skills (DLang microservices handling millions of requests/second at Sociomantic), but the role's primary requirement is modern C++ or Rust, where his experience is limited and dated (a brief C/C++ stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015). His recent focus has been TypeScript/Node full-stack and product work rather than navigation data pipelines, making him a partial fit worth a screening conversation only if the team is open to strong systems engineers ramping up on C++.
strengths: Hands-on geospatial data platform experience as founder of GISCollective and Green Map contributor
Low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems work in DLang (async I/O, caching, fibers)
Broad polyglot background with strong testing culture (TDD, CI/CD, test tooling author)
concerns: Minimal and outdated modern C++ experience; no Rust
No navigation/routing systems or routing-tile pipeline experience
Recent roles centered on TypeScript/Node product work, not systems-level data pipelines
